description: Houston, TX–Today, Congresswoman Lizzie Fletcher (TX-07) released her first television advertisement of the election cycle, “Do Something.” The 30-second spot will run on Houston cable stations through Election Day on March 5 as part of a six-figure buy.

title: Congresswoman Lizzie Fletcher Releases First Ad of 2024 Emphasizing Issues at Stake in 2024 Elections – Lizzie Pannill Fletcher | U.S. Congress | Texas 7th Congressional District
